mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payment_record WHERE obligation_id = #{obligationId} AND record_status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record ( settlement_bank_transaction_id, obligation_id, amount, source_type, record_status, recorded_at ) VALUES ( #{settlementBankTransactionId}, #{obligationId}, #{amount}, #{sourceType}, #{recordStatus}, #{recordedAt} )
